# Three.js module provenance

The Visual & Game Audio hero uses a pinned local copy of the Three.js ES module.

- Source: `montronedsp/LANTERNE/ROMs/cynicviz/lib/three.module.min.js`
- Version: Three.js r161
- Upstream project: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- License: MIT (Three.js Authors, 2010–2023)

The copyright/license banner is preserved in the vendored JavaScript file.

The small site scene at `assets/visual-game-hero.js` borrows the visual vocabulary of the LANTERNE CynicViz ROM: gently evolving procedural color fields and sparse particles. It is a standalone site illustration, with **no microphone or user audio capture**.
